topic: Cozy winter break games, no prep
caption:
Winter break and already hearing "I'm bored"? ❄️

Here are 3 cozy games that use things you already have at home.
No prep, no worksheets, and they work for little kids and bigger kids.
Save this for the first rainy or snowy day off.

What's your family's favourite cozy winter break activity?

#ParentingTips #LearningThroughPlay #WinterBreak #EarlyLearning #CanadianParents

title: Cozy games
no prep needed
items: Hot chocolate math: count, then double the scoops
Word chain: next word starts with the last letter
Page swap: you read one page, they read the next

scenes.sub: A few playful minutes keep learning going, with no pressure.
